name: Dark Portal
summary: At the Blasted Lands' southern rim, the dormant Dark Portal holds a rift between worlds. Its opening brought the Old Horde into Azeroth and began the First War.

sections.title: A Rift Across Realities
sections.body:
Where the Black Morass once spread across the south, the Dark Portal tore open. Medivh, possessed by Sargeras, joined his Tirisfal magics with Gul'dan's fel sorcery on Draenor. Their ritual drained countless lives and ripped reality apart. The Old Horde anchored the rift with massive stonework, then marched through to shatter the Kingdom of Stormwind in the First War.

Fel power from the portal poisoned the land. Lush marshes became the red, petrified wastes you see today.

sections.title: Dormant Vigilance
sections.body:
After the Alliance of Lordaeron won the Second War, Archmage Khadgar shattered the portal's stone frame with powerful magic. He hoped to sever Draenor from Azeroth forever, but the tear beneath it proved impossible to destroy. The Alliance built Nethergarde Keep nearby to watch the scar.

Demons and remnants of the Shadow Council still creep through the blasted caldera. The gateway has been reassembled, yet remains dormant. It is a silent wound between worlds that neither side dares abandon.

faq.q: Can you walk through the Dark Portal right now?
aliases: can i enter the dark portal
faq.answer: No. The Dark Portal's stone frame is intact, but the rift within lies dormant. No traveler can cross it now.

faq.q: Who originally built the Dark Portal?
faq.answer: Medivh, the human Guardian on Azeroth, and Gul'dan, the warlock on Draenor, joined in a ritual to create the Dark Portal. Their work set in motion the invasion that began the First War.

faq.q: Why does Nethergarde Keep watch over it?
faq.answer: After Archmage Khadgar shattered the portal's first frame following the Second War, he persuaded the Alliance to watch its ruins. The Alliance founded Nethergarde Keep to keep watch in case threats returned.

faq.q: Why is the ground around the portal red and barren?
faq.answer: The Blasted Lands were once the fertile Black Morass. Fel magic used to tear reality, corruption from Draenor, and demonic beasts poisoned the soil and petrified the land.

angles.text: For your people, the Dark Portal marks a painful past. Under demonic masters, the Old Horde marched through it and left their ancestral homeland for war.
For the Alliance, the Dark Portal recalls the First War and the fall of ancient Stormwind. The mages of Nethergarde keep watch over it without end.
